capabilities: Read the current note or selection aloud with word-level highlighting
Strip Obsidian markup and add pacing around headings, paragraphs, and list items
Control playback with pause, segment skipping, seeking, and 0.75x-2x speed
Replay cached audio instead of regenerating unchanged passages
Choose among five TTS providers and store their API keys
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile support). Provider usage may incur charges; the plugin itself is free and open source with no server or telemetry. API keys are stored via Obsidian's SecretStorage, and generated audio is cached unencrypted under .obsidian/plugins/murmur/cache/ (up to 500 MB by default), which may be picked up by backups or sync. The README includes an affiliate disclosure for ElevenLabs and documents current limitations such as unreliable selection highlighting and approximate non-ElevenLabs timing.
intentEvidence: Generic read-aloud tools flatten Markdown into mush. Murmur understands the common shapes of an Obsidian note
problem: Obsidian has no built-in read-aloud, and generic TTS tools flatten Markdown structure into unbroken text without pacing or visual tracking.
